text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While passing by the central plaza,
Agnes Digital could be seen peeking at King Halo
from behind cover.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Au-au, King-san...
I'm so worried... Super duper worried...!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
HYAAA?! How long have you been there?!
I didn't do anything, I swear!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: What is all this commotion? What on earth happened?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Ababa... Spotted by the lady herself?!
Is this checkmate for Digi-tan?!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Oh, it's you... I feel as though I have seen you
several times since this morning. Do you have some business with me?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Ah, no, um, well...
I-I-It's nothing at all...!
choice_data_list: You said you were worried just a second ago.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Worried?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Kuh, if it's come to this, I must steel my resolve and commit seppuku...
I mean, confess the whole honest truth!!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Actually... I was worried about you, King-san,
because your circumstances today are so different from usual!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Today is the day of your important mock race, King-san!
You've been pouring your heart and soul into training every single day!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Yes, you seem well-informed.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Ah, and yet! Of all days, the two members
of your entourage are away on an expedition!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Th-that is true...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Which means you are trapped in the abnormal crisis
of missing your daily ritual, the 'Morning King Call'!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Why do you know so much detail?!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
And so, I couldn't help but worry that you wouldn't
be able to bring out your usual peak condition!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
It is true that having my routine disrupted
might prevent me from performing at my best...

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
In that case, as a fan,
I shall grant you the right to cheer for the King!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
You seem to know me very well,
and I am impressed by your enthusiasm!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Official cheering rights authorized by King-san herself?!
To receive such words of blessing...!!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Ha-haa! I am profoundly unworthy yet overjoyed!!
I shall support you with every ounce of my being!!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
You know the King Call, do you not?
Let me hear it!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Who am I?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: The King!!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Stronger than all others?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: The Victor!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: And what of her future?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Radiant! The Horse Girl everyone dreams of becoming~!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Indeed! When one speaks of a first-rate Horse Girl, they speak of me!!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: King Halo!!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Magnificent!
To pull it off so flawlessly.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to that, power is welling up within me!
Watch closely, for I shall seize victory without fail!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
King-san...! A divine halo shines around you!
A legit angel truly worthy of the name King Halo!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Amidst Agnes Digital's fervent cheering,
King Halo achieved a spectacular 1st place finish.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: ...Oh? Where is Digital-san?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
I wished to offer my proper gratitude,
where could she have gone?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Having witnessed King Halo's victory,
Agnes Digital had already quietly slipped away.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
It was an honor to be of service, King-san...
Receiving thanks in person is far too holy for the likes of me!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
As long as I can hear the regular King Call starting tomorrow,
this humble fan is more than satisfied...!
